meta.title: Randolph County — the money trail
meta.note: This is the county's 2026 budget as filed with the state: Ordinance No. 2025-23 and the January 2026 budget detail report, using its "Original Budget" column (it matches the ordinance). The county moves money between its own funds (for example $200,100.00 out of the County General Fund and $196,000.00 out of Solid Waste), so those dollars appear in two funds.
